states.name: Xiao Li
states.title: Indomitable Martial Warrior
states.description: Xiao Li, a skilled practitioner of the martial arts of the distant Middle Kingdom, was spending her days traveling from place to place in search of mighty opponents. After defeating countless renowned warriors, the latest one she sought was Lü Bu, feared throughout the Middle Kingdom as a "Demon of Wrath". A legendary figure, Lü Bu was idolized by Xiao Li as she pursued the title of the strongest warrior to ever live.

states.name: Xiao Li
states.title: Indomitable Martial Warrior
states.description: Then Xiao Li heard a rumor that Lü Bu had died in the Land of Peace. Unable to believe it, she set out to discover the truth—and astonishingly, swam across the sea to reach the Land of Peace. She then traveled from place to place asking after Lü Bu's whereabouts, until at last she found her grave.

states.name: Xiao Li
states.title: Indomitable Martial Warrior
states.description:
"No! You can't be dead before I've fought you!"

Standing before the remains of the figure she had so long admired, Xiao Li cried those words in her heart. Then she placed the Talisman of Revival, a resurrection charm that she had brought from the Middle Kingdom, upon Lü Bu's remains.
She would defeat the strongest warrior she had admired with her own hands, and prove that she herself was the strongest of all.
